raw.rationale: Caffeic acid phenethyl ester is a promiscuous NF-kB/RELA inhibitor with broad antiproliferative activity rather than a lineage-selective cytotoxic mechanism, and PRISM single-concentration screens typically show few selective lineages at the 0.2-2.5% base rate. Any modest lineage differences would most plausibly reflect NF-kB dependency in hematopoietic or inflammatory-linked lineages, none of which are listed, so all listed solid-tumor lineages are assigned near-base-rate probabilities.
